Methodology

Applied loop_count_rules.md. The unit is one source-visible traversal or reduction that creates repeated CHIRRTL. Library-helper internals and Scala desugaring are excluded. Flags describe the construct's own iteration dimension. Direct body LOC excludes nested-loop bodies.
